name: goal_order_development_20261005
intervention: move the identical QUESTIONS plus dispatch block before versus after the identical PAPER block; preserve all words
causal_scope: total block-order effect including resulting plans and handoffs; not an isolated proof of question-conditioned KV mediation
source_identity: one actual autoregressive Planner snapshot per paper/order; native and C2C share exact prefix and current command
quality_denominator: 32 original questions per order/method, every failure retained; repeats are not independent quality samples
quality_metrics: QASPER multi-reference normalized answer token F1
delivery counts are contract counts, not semantic correctness
uncertainty: paired bootstrap of 16 paper means, 5000 resamples, fixed seed 20261005, 95 percent percentile intervals; descriptive development uncertainty
primary_execution_timing: median of three observed workflow walls per paper/order/method; report unadjusted wall and log-subtracted estimate separately; no success-only filtering
evidence_units: original paragraph texts, captions and separately addressable original section headings; no gold-based repair
timing: each method runs three fresh OS workflows from its own reusable background; one measured setup per paper/order; raw execution wall and setup-attributed estimates both reported
timing_balance: alternate protocol order by paper index; rotate method order by paper index plus repeat
stop_rule: stop only for identity, numerical, instrumentation or environment faults; never stop or change papers because quality is low
